From abbd00b82a2771b0460ba2cffdb1343aa827ccde Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wolfgang Grandegger <wg@grandegger.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Nov 2011 14:30:05 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] net/can/mscan: Fix buggy listen only mode setting

This patch fixes an issue introduced recently with commit
452448f9283e1939408b397e87974a418825b0a8.

CC: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>
Signed-off-by: Wolfgang Grandegger <wg@grandegger.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c b/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c
index 74f3b1829e02..1c82dd8b896e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c
@@ -581,7 +581,7 @@ static int mscan_open(struct net_device *dev)
 
 	priv->open_time = jiffies;
 
-	if (ctrlmode.flags & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
+	if (priv->can.ctrlmode & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
 		setbits8(&regs->canctl1, MSCAN_LISTEN);
 	else
 		clrbits8(&regs->canctl1, MSCAN_LISTEN);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/can/mscan/mscan.c`**
- The condition for setting the listen-only mode has been modified. 
- The original line:
  ```c
  if (ctrlmode.flags & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
  ```
  has been changed to:
  ```c
  if (priv->can.ctrlmode & CAN_CTRLMODE_LISTENONLY)
  ```
- This change ensures that the listen-only mode is determined based on the `priv->can.ctrlmode` instead of `ctrlmode.flags`.

### Relationships
- The modification in `mscan.c` addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (identified by the hash `452448f9283e1939408b397e87974a418825b0a8`). The patch corrects the logic for enabling the listen-only mode in the CAN driver, ensuring that the correct control mode is checked before setting the appropriate bits in the hardware register. This fix is crucial for the proper functioning of the listen-only mode in the CAN network interface.
